claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition
claims.evidence: No close-up of body condition, no power-on or stitching test shown; only a distant tabletop shot.

claims.claim: just buy and use (implies fully functional)
claims.evidence: No video or photo showing the machine powering on or stitching; functionality cannot be confirmed from a static image.

risks.risk: Brand/model unreadable, so authenticity and parts value unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/front panel text
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unbranded tabletop sewing machine

risks.risk: Motor, belt, and internal mechanism condition unknown
risks.proof: Short video of the machine running and stitching on fabric
risks.if_unproven: price as non-functional/for-parts until shown working

risks.risk: Missing accessories (bobbins, needles, manual, power cable)
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories laid out next to the machine

risks.risk: Hidden rust, wear, or damage on underside/back
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's underside and rear panel
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically worn, worst case

risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, warranty card, or serial number photo

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate
Video of the machine powering on and stitching fabric
Photo of included accessories (bobbins, needles, manual, cable)
Photo of the machine's underside and rear for rust/damage
Any serial number, receipt, or warranty documentation
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a sewing machine, so it can be priced at worst case (unbranded, unverified function, no accessories) pending the listed proofs; seller's unverified condition claim does not block pricing.
